tcs.tc_title: X closes the rear image, press X and check that the rear view camera image is closed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The shift lever is in P
4. The rear view camera image is displayed in Manual Display Mode
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "X" exit button on the top right corner of the HU display
2. Read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is closed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "X" exit button registers the press
2. The rear view camera image is closed and the HU returns to the previous screen
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
When the user presses the X on the top right corner of the HU screen, the HU shall receive the internal signal RVC IMAGE OFF and shall close the image of the rear area of the vehicle.

(X closes the rear image, press X and check that the rear view camera image is closed)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 CFTS092 `SYS-RA-CAM-082`（ObjectID 4781647，Rear Camera 節）之「按下右上角 X → HU 收到內部訊號 RVC IMAGE OFF → 關閉後方影像」。**內部訊號 `RVC IMAGE OFF` 不可觀察** —— `forms/` 四本 DBC 全文字面掃描 `RVC IMAGE` 零命中，其為 HU 內部事件，依 §6 以其後果（影像關閉）判定；寫法同 `NR1L-RVC-036` 之 `CHMC IMAGE ON`。**與 `NR1L-RVC-006`（pilot02，手動關閉）之分工**：`-006` 之錨為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V2-549`，承接列為 `SWE-CAM-016`；本列之錨 `CAM-082` 承接列為 `SWE-CAM-001`（R-CAM10），二者為不同來源之同型行為，各自承接、不互相委派。前提取 Manual Display Mode —— 自動模式下退出由排檔決定，X 鍵之疊加另見 `NR1L-RVC-021`。
